Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. As part of our security review for the EU pilot, our InfoSec + Legal teams need a consolidated, "sealed" evidence packet that proves:

- Hosting locality (primary compute and persistent storage must be in EU regions)
- Private connectivity options (VPC peering/Private Link, egress control)
- Key management (customer partitioning, KMS/HSM boundaries and rotation)
- Data movement/egress audit paths and logging (how to prove tokens never leave EU)

Can you provide one PDF that bundles the architecture diagram, SOC 2 summary, CAIQ/SIG responses, and a short operations runbook? We prefer a single artifact for ingestion to our vendor risk platform.

Also please call out any fallback model routing (hosted -> dedicated -> private) and whether fallback could cross regions in a failover event.

Deadline: we need this by COB Tuesday (2027-06-29) to keep the pilot on track.

Thanks,
Sandra

Head of Vendor Security
Earthbound Health

Sharing method: we can either upload the sealed packet to your vendor portal (please confirm upload link) or share via an encrypted drive link and create a one-time download token.

Looping in Irene for KMS/HSM details.

Hi all —

Adding KMS/HSM specifics for the packet:

- Key topology: We offer both Redwood-managed key partitions and BYOK (customer-managed keys) via integratable KMS. For the EU pilot we recommend BYOK when customers require exclusive control; the packet will show the BYOK flow and the partitioned key policy for Redwood-managed keys.
- HSM evidence: We provide attestations from our HSM vendor (FIPS 140-2 Level 3 equivalent) and will include the HSM location constraints we currently enforce for EU-only keys.
- Rotation & audit: Key rotation policies (90 days default, configurable) and CloudTrail-style audit trails are retained and filtered by region. We'll include a sample audit extract demonstrating a EU-sourced key usage event.
- Access controls: KMS admin roles are segmented by operator team and require 2-person approval for destructive operations.

I'll add a short table in the CAIQ/SIG spreadsheet that maps each KMS claim to evidence: config snippet, audit extract, and HSM attestation PDF.

Irene
Irene Choi
Security Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: none (will include attestation PDFs in packet)

Sandra / team —

I've attached the final evidence bundle to this thread (sealed PDF + supporting files). Highlights to call out in the packet:

- Egress controls: Per-tenant network policies + regional egress ACLs prevent outbound flows from EU compute to non-EU destinations. We also include an example of our VPC Flow logs correlated with request IDs for a 7-day period.
- Private connectivity: Diagram includes AWS Privatelink and dedicated peering options for on-prem customers, plus our recommended private peering checklist.
- Fallback behavior: Default platform failover is intra-region only. Cross-region promoter requires an agreed DR policy signoff and is not automatic. We included the rollout/rollback checklist for canary and emergency DR starts.
- Evidence attachments: soc2-type2-summary-2026.pdf (summary), sig-responses-2027Q2.xlsx (with an evidence column), network-diagram-vpc-privatelink.png, redwood_geo_evidence_packet_20270625.pdf (sealed).

Please confirm whether you want the sealed packet uploaded to Hub or if Earthbound Legal prefers a DocuSign-protected delivery (we can produce a sealed envelope + tamper log).

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Product Operations — Redwood Console

Attachments: redwood_geo_evidence_packet_20270625.pdf (sealed, 4.1MB), network-diagram-vpc-privatelink.png (420KB), sig-responses-2027Q2.xlsx (120KB), soc2-type2-summary-2026.pdf (540KB)
